ribs, the two diagonal families of grid B, each 160

Corner blocks: the four hip ribs, cut across the

from your sketches

Notes
Heights are levels from the ground floor (eave +2.50,
crown +8.50). Large slice at +6.00 (3500 above the eave),
1:50, just below the middle horizontal rib of option A
Option B: the same two diagonal families at every height,
clipped by the hips; the cut ribs move towards the corners
as the roof narrows. At the crown (+8.50) only the hips
and the top ring are left.
Layer 2 thins towards the crown (the leaf is 160 at the
base, 80 at the crown). Ribs use the same geometry as the
roof-grid sheets; bars and stirrups are assumed.
